gloss: naturally; of itself; in the nature of things

definitions.gloss: naturally; of its own accord; as a matter of course
definitions.explanation: Describes an outcome that follows naturally from the way things are, without anyone forcing it. Literary and somewhat elevated; common in essays, aphorisms, and formal speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧おのずから⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧だ。
⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧、おのずから⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{開|ひら}ける→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: If you keep at it, a path will open up of its own accord.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}われば→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{物事|ものごと}→物事：00291_monogoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見|み}え→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧おのずから⟦{変|か}わって→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧くる。
examples.english: When your position changes, the way things look naturally changes with it.

notes:
Also written {自|おの}ずから. The literary variant of ⟦おのずと→おのずと：06714_onozuto⟧, with which it is interchangeable in most contexts; おのずから sounds a shade more formal and is preferred in writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- おのずから⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧だ: is naturally obvious
- おのずから⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: will become clear in due course
- おのずから⟦{限界|げんかい}→限界：02715_genkai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are natural limits

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦おのずと→おのずと：06714_onozuto⟧: naturally — the same word in its ordinary modern form
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧: naturally — the casual everyday counterpart
- ⟦ひとりでに→ひとりでに：30288_hitorideni⟧: by itself — about the absence of an agent, not about a natural course of events
